## WrapperSpec.noArgFlagPattern property

A regular expression matched against a whole flag-position word for flag \*shapes\* that aren't fixed strings — e.g. `nice`<!-- -->'s legacy attached adjustment form (`nice -10 cmd`<!-- -->). Consumes no separate operand word, like [WrapperSpec.noArgFlags](./sh-analysis.wrapperspec.noargflags.md)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly noArgFlagPattern?: RegExp;
```
